name: Toaru Hahaoya no Ayamachi ~Yukari Sono Kouhen~
original_name: とある母親の過ち～縁その後篇～
source:
"Mother has been acting weird lately..."
The whole things happen in a summer a while after Kento thought that.

Sensing something wrong with his mother, Kento check an SNS page...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE216930.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“妈妈最近表现得很奇怪……”

贤人产生这个想法后的某个夏天，一切事情开始发生。

感觉母亲不对劲的贤人查看了一个社交网络页面……
